 This Petition Coming On For Admission This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Accused is before this Court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C with a prayer to quash the entire proceedings in Crime No.95/2023 registered by the Kamalapur Police Station, Kalaburagi for the offences punishable under Sections 409 and 420 of IPC on the basis of the first information dated 11.09.2023 received from the Executive Officer, Taluk Panchayat, Kamalapur, Kalaburagi district.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the basis of the instruction from the Chief Executive Officer of Zilla Panchayat and the Executive Officer of NC: 2024:KHC-K:3893 Taluk Panchayat, Kalaburagi, order was placed by the Grampanchayat, Dongargaun with Sri K.S.Traders for the purpose of supply of material for solar panel and also to install the same within the jurisdiction of the Grampanchayat.
Since, Sri K.S.Traders had failed to supply the materials in spite of payment being made by the Grampanchayat, action has been taken against him by filing the police complaint.

However, on the basis of the first information received from the Executive Officer of Taluk Panchayat, Kamalapur impugned proceedings is initiated against the petitioner, who is the Panchayat Development Officer of Kinni Sadak Grampanchayat.

He submits that the payment made by the petitioner was as per the instructions received on the basis of the decision taken by the Sangeetha Biredar vs The State Of Karnataka And Anr on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50500373/
2 Grampanchayat and therefore, alleged offences do not get attracted against the petitioner.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader appearing for respondent No.1/State has opposed the petition.

The material on record would go to show that communications dated 26.07.2022 and 04.08.2022 was issued by the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat, Kalaburagi and Executive Officer, Taluk Panchayat, Kalamapur respectively to the office bearers of Grampanchayat and the Chief Executive Officer of the Grampanchayats are coming within the limits of Kalaburagi Zilla Panchayat,
requesting them to place orders for supply of solar panel materials with Sri K.S.Traders, who was the authorized supplier of said materials to the Zilla Panchayat and Taluk Panchayat.
It appears that on the basis of the aforesaid communication received, a decision was taken by Dongargaun Grampanchayat to place the order for supply of solar panel materials with Sri K.S.Traders.
Accordingly, a sum of `3,40,000/- was released to the account of Sri K.S.Traders on four different dates for the purpose of supply of the solar panel materials.

It appears that since Sri K.S.Traders failed to honour his commitment in spite of he receiving the payments from the Grampanchayat, a NC: 2024:KHC-K:3893 police complaint was lodged on 27.12.2022 before the Kamalapur Police Station against the Proprietor of Sri K.S.Traders by the President and the Panchayat Development Officer of Dongargaun Grampanchayat.

Subsequently, the aforesaid proprietor of Sri K.S.Traders has also issued a letter to the President of Grampanchayat informing him that the delay in supplying the material was due to the fact that the material received by him were damaged and he had apologized for the delay in executing the work.
6.

From the aforesaid material, it is very clear that the payment of advance amount for supply of the solar panels material was made by the petitioner as per the instructions received from the Chief Executive Officer of Zilla Panchayat and the Executive Officer of Taluk Panchayat.
Under the circumstances, the allegations made against the petitioner prima facie appear to be false and no case for the alleged offences can be made out against the petitioner.
Therefore, I am of the opinion that NC: 2024:KHC-K:3893 continuation of the criminal proceedings as against the petitioner amounts to abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER
The criminal petition is allowed.

The entire proceedings in Crime No.95/2023 registered by Kamalapur Police Station, Kalaburagi as against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 409 and 420 of IPC, pending on the file of I Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Kalaburagi stands quashed.
